_note: Hand-curated preset selections for the map explorer (map.html). Each group is a name, a one-line blurb, a suggested base-map extent, and an ordered list of place_id values that must exist in data/places-index.json with coordinates. Not generated — edit by hand; verify every id against the index before adding. Groups are listed in rough biblical-chronological order; keep new groups in that order.
